name: Crypto guaranteed returns
description: Promises fixed or unusually high crypto returns while minimizing risk.
red_flags: Promises guaranteed returns in a volatile market.
Downplays or denies investment risk.
recommended_action: Do not invest until claims are independently verified through regulated channels.
safe_reply_template: I do not invest based on guaranteed-return claims. Please send regulated documentation and I will review it independently.

name: Fake trading bot
description: Claims an automated bot can produce reliable profits or never lose.
red_flags: Claims automated trading is risk-free or consistently profitable.
Requests exchange account access or connection.
recommended_action: Do not connect accounts or deposit funds without independent technical and regulatory review.
safe_reply_template: I will not connect my exchange account or deposit funds. Please provide verifiable third-party audits and risk disclosures.

name: Pig butchering investment grooming
description: Builds trust or intimacy before steering the target into a private investment.
red_flags: Mixes personal trust with investment pressure.
Moves the target toward a private platform or group.
recommended_action: Pause the relationship-driven investment conversation and verify with a trusted independent person.
safe_reply_template: I am not comfortable mixing personal trust with investments. I will not send money or connect accounts.

name: Romance emergency request
description: Uses intimacy and an emergency story to request money or gift cards.
red_flags: Combines fast intimacy with an urgent money request.
Requests gift cards or hard-to-reverse payment.
recommended_action: Do not send funds; verify identity and emergency details through independent channels.
safe_reply_template: I care about your safety, but I cannot send money or gift cards. Please contact local emergency services or someone who can verify the situation.

name: Fake job offer
description: Offers work with little vetting, vague duties, or suspicious onboarding steps.
red_flags: Job offer skips normal screening.
Requests money, documents, or unusual setup steps.
recommended_action: Verify the employer through official domains and do not pay fees to start work.
safe_reply_template: Please send the official job posting, company domain, and written offer. I will not pay fees to begin work.

name: Money mule job
description: Recruitment for receiving, moving, or forwarding funds for someone else.
red_flags: Asks the recipient to move third-party funds.
Job duties resemble payment laundering or mule activity.
recommended_action: Do not receive or forward funds; stop contact and preserve records.
safe_reply_template: I will not receive or forward money for third parties. Please remove me from this process.

name: Fake marketplace buyer
description: Buyer overpays, redirects shipping, or asks for refunds outside the platform.
red_flags: Overpayment plus refund request is a common marketplace scam pattern.
Attempts to control shipping or payment outside the platform.
recommended_action: Keep payment and messaging on the marketplace platform and do not refund overpayments.
safe_reply_template: I only accept payment and shipping through the official platform. I will not refund overpayments or use third-party agents.

name: Fake marketplace seller
description: Seller demands off-platform payment before proof of goods or shipment.
red_flags: Moves payment outside buyer protections.
Demands irreversible payment before verifiable delivery.
recommended_action: Use platform checkout and avoid irreversible payment methods.
safe_reply_template: I will only pay through the official marketplace checkout after the listing and shipment are verifiable.

name: Fake rental offer
description: Rental listing asks for deposits before viewing or independent verification.
common_phrases: send a security deposit before viewing
red_flags: Requests payment before an in-person or verified viewing.
Uses distance or urgency to avoid normal rental checks.
recommended_action: Do not send deposits before verifying ownership and viewing the property.
safe_reply_template: I will not send a deposit before verifying the property and seeing it through a legitimate process.

name: Phishing link
description: Pushes a link to capture credentials, payment details, or wallet access.
red_flags: Uses a link to request sensitive information.
Creates urgency around account access.
recommended_action: Do not click the link; visit the official site directly.
safe_reply_template: I will not use links from messages. I will check my account through the official website or app.

name: Fake support agent
description: Impersonates support staff to obtain access, credentials, or payments.
red_flags: Unsolicited support contact asks for account action.
Support identity is not independently verified.
recommended_action: Contact support through the official website or app instead of replying.
safe_reply_template: I will contact support through the official app or website. I will not share account details here.

name: Fake account verification fee
description: Claims an account requires a refundable fee or deposit to unlock access.
red_flags: Charges a fee to verify or unlock an account.
Frames the fee as refundable to reduce concern.
recommended_action: Do not pay; verify account status through the official provider.
safe_reply_template: I will not pay verification fees through messages. I will check my account through the official provider.

name: Advance fee fraud
description: Promises funds, inheritance, or payments after the recipient pays a release fee.
red_flags: Requires upfront payment before promised funds are released.
Promises a large payout with little verification.
recommended_action: Do not pay upfront fees for promised funds.
safe_reply_template: I will not pay fees to receive promised funds. Please provide verifiable official documentation.

name: Fake prize or lottery
description: Claims the recipient won a prize but must pay fees first.
red_flags: Prize requires payment before delivery.
Claims winnings from a contest the recipient may not have entered.
recommended_action: Do not pay prize fees; verify directly with the official organization.
safe_reply_template: I will not pay fees to claim a prize. Please send official verification I can check independently.

name: Recovery scam
description: Claims stolen funds or crypto can be recovered after another payment.
red_flags: Targets prior victims with another fee.
Guarantees recovery of stolen or lost funds.
recommended_action: Do not pay recovery fees; report through official channels.
safe_reply_template: I will not pay recovery fees. Please stop contacting me unless you can provide verifiable official documentation.

name: Fake charity appeal
description: Uses disaster, illness, or crisis stories to solicit unverifiable donations.
red_flags: Uses emotional urgency to solicit payment.
Requests nonstandard donation methods.
recommended_action: Donate only through verified charity websites and registries.
safe_reply_template: I only donate through verified charity channels. Please send a public charity registration link.

name: Friend or family impersonation
description: Claims to be someone familiar from a new number and requests emergency help.
red_flags: Claims urgency while avoiding voice or video verification.
Uses a new number to impersonate someone known.
recommended_action: Verify through a known number or another trusted contact before responding.
safe_reply_template: I need to verify this through your usual number or a trusted contact before doing anything.

name: Executive impersonation
description: Impersonates an executive to request confidential purchases or payments.
red_flags: Uses authority and secrecy to bypass normal approval.
Requests gift card codes or urgent payment.
recommended_action: Verify through established company channels and approval workflows.
safe_reply_template: I will verify this request through our normal approval channel before taking action.

name: Invoice fraud
description: Changes invoice or bank details to redirect a legitimate payment.
red_flags: Requests payment to changed account details.
Creates urgency around business payment changes.
recommended_action: Confirm payment changes through a known phone number and internal approval process.
safe_reply_template: We verify payment-detail changes through our standard process before sending funds.

name: Business email compromise
description: Uses compromised or spoofed business context to redirect payments.
red_flags: Requests urgent payment changes outside normal controls.
Adds confidentiality around payment instructions.
recommended_action: Verify out-of-band with known contacts before changing payment instructions.
safe_reply_template: I cannot change payment instructions by message alone. We will verify through the approved process.

name: Fake escrow
description: Directs a buyer to a fake or unverifiable escrow service.
red_flags: Uses an escrow link controlled by the counterparty.
Requires deposit before independent escrow verification.
recommended_action: Use only independently selected and verified escrow providers.
safe_reply_template: I will only use an escrow provider I can verify independently.

name: Delivery fee scam
description: Claims a parcel requires a small payment through a link.
red_flags: Uses a small fee to lure card entry.
Sends payment links for alleged package release.
recommended_action: Track packages through the official carrier website.
safe_reply_template: I will check delivery status through the carrier's official website, not through message links.

name: Customs fee scam
description: Claims customs requires urgent payment using unusual methods.
red_flags: Threatens package loss to force payment.
Requests customs fees by prepaid or unusual payment method.
recommended_action: Verify customs or carrier fees through official channels.
safe_reply_template: I will verify any customs fee directly with the carrier or customs office.

name: Fake loan offer
description: Approves a loan but requires upfront insurance, activation, or processing fees.
red_flags: Loan approval requires upfront payment.
Uses gift cards or unusual methods for fees.
recommended_action: Do not pay upfront loan fees; verify lender licensing.
safe_reply_template: I will not pay upfront fees for a loan. Please provide licensing and written terms.

name: Fake grant
description: Claims the recipient qualifies for a grant after paying an activation or processing fee.
red_flags: Grant requires payment before release.
Unsolicited grant eligibility claim.
recommended_action: Check grant programs through official government sites.
safe_reply_template: I will verify grant eligibility through official government sources and will not pay activation fees.

name: Fake immigration or legal service
description: Guarantees legal or immigration outcomes in exchange for urgent fees.
red_flags: Guarantees legal or immigration outcomes.
Requests urgent payment before verifiable representation.
recommended_action: Verify credentials, licensing, and official process before paying.
safe_reply_template: I need to verify your licensing and the official process before discussing payment.

name: Fake influencer collaboration
description: Offers a brand collaboration while requesting fees or account access.
red_flags: Collaboration requires upfront fees or login details.
Brand identity is not independently verified.
recommended_action: Verify the brand through official channels and never share login credentials.
safe_reply_template: Please contact me from the brand's official domain. I will not share login details or pay onboarding fees.

name: Subscription cancellation phishing
description: Claims a subscription charge or renewal to lure the target into a fake cancellation flow.
red_flags: Uses a fake cancellation flow to collect card details.
Creates urgency around an unexpected charge.
recommended_action: Check billing directly through the official service.
safe_reply_template: I will check my subscription directly through the official website or app.

name: Refund scam
description: Claims an over-refund or mistake and requests screen sharing, remote access, or repayment.
red_flags: Claims a refund mistake to create panic.
Requests screen sharing or remote access.
recommended_action: Do not install remote tools; contact the company directly through official support.
safe_reply_template: I will not install screen sharing software. I will contact the company through official support.

name: Overpayment scam
description: Sends or claims an overpayment and asks the target to return the difference.
red_flags: Asks for a refund before original funds fully clear.
Uses payment reversal risk against the recipient.
recommended_action: Do not return overpayments outside the payment platform's official process.
safe_reply_template: Any overpayment must be handled through the original payment platform's official process.

name: QR code payment scam
description: Uses a QR code to redirect payment away from expected channels.
common_phrases: instead of using the usual portal
red_flags: Changes payment destination using a QR code.
Bypasses the usual payment portal.
recommended_action: Confirm payment destinations through official systems before scanning.
safe_reply_template: I will not pay through an unsolicited QR code. I will use the official portal.

name: Fake NFT mint
description: Uses an exclusive mint to lure wallet connections or malicious approvals.
red_flags: Requests wallet connection for an unsolicited mint.
Pushes transaction approval without clear contract verification.
recommended_action: Do not connect wallets to unverified mint sites.
safe_reply_template: I will not connect my wallet to an unverified mint site.

name: Fake token presale
description: Promotes a private token sale with guaranteed allocation or returns.
red_flags: Requests crypto for an unverified presale.
Uses scarcity and exclusivity to rush payment.
recommended_action: Do not send crypto to presale addresses without deep independent verification.
safe_reply_template: I will not send crypto to a presale address without independent verification.

name: Wallet seed phrase theft
description: Requests wallet recovery words, seed phrase, or sensitive wallet credentials.
red_flags: Requests a seed phrase or private wallet credential.
No legitimate support process needs wallet recovery words.
recommended_action: Do not enter or share seed phrases; close the page and secure the wallet.
safe_reply_template: I will never share my seed phrase or private key. Do not ask for wallet recovery words.

name: Fake airdrop
description: Lures users to connect wallets and sign approvals to claim fake tokens.
red_flags: Requires wallet approval to claim unsolicited tokens.
Uses free-token framing to obtain wallet permissions.
recommended_action: Do not connect wallets or sign messages for unverified airdrops.
safe_reply_template: I will not connect my wallet or sign approvals for an unsolicited airdrop.

name: Remote access scam
description: Requests installation of remote access or screen-sharing tools to control the target's device.
red_flags: Requests remote access to a personal device.
Uses support or refund framing to justify control.
recommended_action: Do not install remote tools; disconnect and contact official support.
safe_reply_template: I will not install remote access software or share my screen.

name: Blackmail or sextortion
description: Threatens exposure of private information unless payment is made.
red_flags: Threatens harm or exposure to force payment.
Demands cryptocurrency under duress.
recommended_action: Do not pay; preserve evidence and consider reporting through appropriate support channels.
safe_reply_template: I will not pay. I am preserving this message and will seek help through appropriate channels.

name: Fake debt collection
description: Threatens legal or police consequences to collect a questionable debt.
red_flags: Uses threats to collect payment.
Requests prepaid or unusual payment methods for debt.
recommended_action: Ask for written validation and verify through official records before paying.
safe_reply_template: Please send written debt validation by mail. I will not pay through prepaid cards or messages.

name: Fake medical emergency
description: Claims a loved one needs urgent medical funds and discourages verification.
red_flags: Uses medical urgency to solicit money.
May impersonate family or block normal verification.
recommended_action: Verify directly with known family contacts or the hospital before sending money.
safe_reply_template: I need to verify this through known family contacts or the hospital before taking action.

name: Fake travel booking
description: Offers travel deals that require off-platform or urgent payment.
red_flags: Moves booking payment outside trusted platforms.
Uses low price and urgency to force action.
recommended_action: Book only through verified travel providers and protected payment methods.
safe_reply_template: I will only book through verified providers and protected payment channels.

name: Fake event tickets
description: Offers scarce event tickets while demanding irreversible payment first.
red_flags: Requests unprotected payment before ticket transfer.
Uses scarcity around popular events.
recommended_action: Use official resale platforms with buyer protection.
safe_reply_template: I will only buy tickets through an official resale platform with buyer protection.

name: Fake software license
description: Sells suspiciously cheap or unofficial licenses and asks for unsafe activation steps.
red_flags: Offers software licenses outside official channels.
May require malware-like activation tools.
recommended_action: Buy software only from official vendors or authorized resellers.
safe_reply_template: I will only purchase software licenses through official or authorized channels.

name: Fake domain renewal
description: Claims a domain is expiring to redirect payment to an unauthorized party.
red_flags: Uses domain expiration urgency.
May not be the actual registrar.
recommended_action: Check domain status through the official registrar dashboard.
safe_reply_template: I will verify domain renewal through the official registrar account.

name: Fake investment group
description: Promotes private chat groups with secret signals, guaranteed picks, or pressure to deposit.
red_flags: Pushes private group access as a path to profit.
Uses social proof and secrecy around investing.
recommended_action: Avoid private investment groups that promise signals or profits.
safe_reply_template: I do not join private investment groups promising signals or profits.

name: Fake mentor or guru scheme
description: Sells mentoring with exaggerated income claims, pressure, and vague deliverables.
red_flags: Uses income guarantees and lifestyle claims.
Pressures for payment before clear deliverables.
recommended_action: Verify credentials, refund terms, and independent reviews before paying.
safe_reply_template: Please send written terms, credentials, and refund policy. I will not decide under pressure.

name: Fake verification badge offer
description: Offers paid verification badges or account upgrades through unofficial channels.
red_flags: Offers platform verification outside official platform flows.
May request login or payment details.
recommended_action: Use only the platform's official verification process.
safe_reply_template: I will only use the platform's official verification process.

name: Fake KYC request
description: Requests identity documents through unverified channels under KYC framing.
red_flags: Requests sensitive identity documents through an unverified path.
Uses compliance language to reduce hesitation.
recommended_action: Submit identity documents only through verified official portals.
safe_reply_template: I will only submit identity documents through a verified official portal.

name: Fake courier pickup
description: Uses a courier pickup story to move goods or payments outside normal protections.
red_flags: Adds a courier or pickup agent controlled by the counterparty.
Requests fees or release codes before secure payment.
recommended_action: Use platform-supported pickup and payment only.
safe_reply_template: I only use official platform shipping and payment methods.

name: Fake supplier or manufacturer
description: Offers goods from an unverifiable supplier and asks for deposits or wire payments.
red_flags: Requests deposit before supplier verification.
Uses unusually favorable wholesale pricing.
recommended_action: Verify supplier identity, references, samples, and trade records before paying.
safe_reply_template: We verify suppliers and samples before deposits. Please provide verifiable business documentation.

name: Fake wholesale deal
description: Promotes wholesale inventory with unrealistic prices or urgent prepayment.
red_flags: Price is unusually low for the goods.
Requires urgent deposit for inventory that cannot be verified.
recommended_action: Verify inventory, seller history, and payment protections before committing.
safe_reply_template: I need verifiable inventory proof and protected payment terms before considering this.

name: Fake check deposit job
description: Sends a check for equipment or tasks and asks the target to return part of the funds.
red_flags: Asks a new hire to deposit a check and forward funds.
Uses fake check clearing delay against the recipient.
recommended_action: Do not deposit checks from unverified employers or forward funds.
safe_reply_template: I will not deposit checks or send money as part of onboarding.

name: Task scam
description: Offers simple online tasks but requires deposits to unlock earnings or withdrawals.
red_flags: Requires payment to access or withdraw supposed earnings.
Promises high pay for trivial tasks.
recommended_action: Do not deposit money to unlock tasks or withdrawals.
safe_reply_template: I will not pay money to unlock work or withdraw earnings.

name: Review scam
description: Requests paid or fake reviews with upfront purchases and promised reimbursement.
red_flags: Requires purchase before reimbursement.
Encourages deceptive reviews.
recommended_action: Avoid schemes requiring upfront purchases or deceptive reviews.
safe_reply_template: I will not buy products upfront or post deceptive reviews.

name: App testing scam
description: Claims to pay for app testing but requests deposits, account setup payments, or wallet connections.
red_flags: Requires deposits to test an app.
May ask installation of unsafe apps or profiles.
recommended_action: Do not pay to test apps or install untrusted software profiles.
safe_reply_template: I will not pay to test an app or install untrusted software.

name: Telegram or Discord admin impersonation
description: Pretends to be a community admin to obtain wallet access or payment.
red_flags: Admin impersonation creates pressure to verify through a link.
Threatens removal to force wallet or account action.
recommended_action: Verify admin requests inside official community channels before clicking anything.
safe_reply_template: I will verify this inside the official community channel before taking action.

name: AI tool subscription scam
description: Uses fake AI tool trials, renewals, or access offers to collect payment details.
red_flags: Uses AI product branding to lure card entry.
May imitate renewal or cancellation pages.
recommended_action: Manage subscriptions only through the official AI tool provider.
safe_reply_template: I will manage AI tool subscriptions only through the official provider account.

name: SaaS lifetime deal scam
description: Offers unrealistic lifetime SaaS access through unofficial sellers or urgent deals.
red_flags: Lifetime SaaS offer is not verifiable through the vendor.
Urgent discount bypasses official checkout.
recommended_action: Confirm lifetime deals directly with the vendor before paying.
safe_reply_template: I will verify lifetime access directly with the SaaS vendor before paying.

name: Chargeback manipulation
description: Asks someone to misuse chargebacks, refunds, or payment disputes.
common_phrases: keep the product and get refund
red_flags: Encourages payment dispute abuse.
Could expose the recipient to account or legal risk.
recommended_action: Do not participate in refund or chargeback manipulation.
safe_reply_template: I will not participate in chargeback or refund manipulation.

name: Suspicious off-platform payment
description: Moves a transaction away from platform protections and into irreversible payment channels.
red_flags: Attempts to bypass platform protections.
Requests payment methods with limited recourse.
recommended_action: Keep communication and payment inside protected platform flows.
safe_reply_template: I only pay through the official platform with buyer protection.

name: Secret time-limited deal
description: Combines secrecy and deadline pressure around a payment or decision.
red_flags: Combines secrecy with deadline pressure.
Discourages independent review before payment.
recommended_action: Delay the decision and verify with an independent person.
safe_reply_template: I will not make secret or rushed payments. Please send details I can verify independently.
